items.body: A bag is marked at 800 and sold at a 15% discount. What is the selling price?
items.explanation: A 15% discount leaves 85% of the price: 800 x 0.85 = 680.
items.shortcut: Take the discount, not the price: 10% of 800 is 80 and 5% is 40, so the discount is 120 and the price 680.

items.body: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their sum is 96. What is the larger number?
items.explanation: The parts add to 3 + 5 = 8, so one part is 96 / 8 = 12 and the larger number is 5 x 12 = 60.
items.shortcut: Divide the total by the sum of the ratio parts, then multiply by your part.

items.body: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 10 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
items.explanation: Passing a pole means covering its own length: 150 / 10 = 15 m/s. Multiply by 18/5 to get km/h: 15 x 3.6 = 54.
items.shortcut: m/s to km/h: multiply by 3.6 (or by 18 and divide by 5).

items.body: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, how many days do they take?
items.explanation: In one day they do 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 of the job, so the job takes 36/5 = 7.2 days.
items.shortcut: Two workers: (a x b) / (a + b) = (12 x 18) / 30 = 7.2.

items.body: An item bought for 400 is sold for 500. What is the profit percentage?
items.explanation: Profit is 100 and profit percent is always measured on the cost price: 100 / 400 = 25%.
items.shortcut: Profit over cost, not over selling price. 100 on 400 is a quarter.

items.body: What is the simple interest on 5000 at 8% per year for 3 years?
items.explanation: Simple interest = principal x rate x time / 100 = 5000 x 8 x 3 / 100 = 1200.
items.shortcut: 8% of 5000 is 400 a year, so three years is 1200.

items.body: What is the compound interest on 10000 at 10% per year for 2 years, compounded yearly?
items.explanation: After two years the amount is 10000 x 1.1 x 1.1 = 12100, so the interest is 2100.

items.body: Two fair dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum is 7?
items.explanation: Six of the 36 equally likely outcomes sum to 7: (1,6), (2,5), (3,4), (4,3), (5,2), (6,1). So 6/36 = 1/6.
items.shortcut: 7 is the most likely sum of two dice: whatever the first die shows, exactly one value on the second works.

items.body: In how many ways can a committee of 3 be chosen from 6 people?
items.explanation: Order does not matter, so it is C(6,3) = 6 x 5 x 4 / (3 x 2 x 1) = 20.
items.shortcut: C(n,r): write r factors counting down from n over r factorial.

items.body: How many different arrangements can be made from all the letters of the word LEVEL?
items.explanation: There are 5 letters, with L twice and E twice: 5! / (2! x 2!) = 120 / 4 = 30.
items.shortcut: Divide the factorial of the length by the factorial of each repeated letter's count.

items.body: The average of five numbers is 24. When one of them, 30, is removed, what is the average of the other four?
items.explanation: The five numbers add to 5 x 24 = 120. Without 30 they add to 90, and 90 / 4 = 22.5.
items.shortcut: Work with totals: total = average x count.

items.body: The ages of a father and his son are in the ratio 7 : 2. In 10 years the ratio will be 9 : 4. How old is the father now?
items.explanation: Let the ages be 7x and 2x. Then (7x + 10) / (2x + 10) = 9/4, so 28x + 40 = 18x + 90, giving x = 5. The father is 35 (and the son 10: in 10 years 45 : 20 = 9 : 4).
items.shortcut: Test the options: only 35 with a son of 10 gives 45 : 20 = 9 : 4 after 10 years.

items.explanation: 10% of 240 is 24 and 5% is 12, so 15% is 36.

items.body: One pipe fills a tank in 6 hours and another pipe empties it in 12 hours. With both open, in how many hours is the empty tank full? (Give a number.)
items.explanation: Net rate per hour is 1/6 - 1/12 = 1/12 of the tank, so it takes 12 hours.
items.shortcut: Filling counts positive, emptying negative: add the rates.

items.body: Two trains, 100 m and 120 m long, run towards each other at 36 km/h and 54 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely?
items.explanation: Opposite directions: speeds add, 36 + 54 = 90 km/h = 25 m/s. They must cover 100 + 120 = 220 m, which takes 220 / 25 = 8.8 s.
items.shortcut: Same direction subtract the speeds, opposite directions add them. Add the lengths.
